movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Couples join hands to create arches.
movement_profile.footwork: Three running steps followed by a hop on the fourth beat with a slight inward kick.
movement_profile.partnering: Couples work together to form arches and lead the procession.

signature_moves.description: Three running steps keeping the feet close to the ground and a hop on the fourth beat.
signature_moves.name: Manx Reel Step

music_profile.musical_form: Two parts, each eight bars long.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is a traditional tune specifically associated with the hop-tu-naa dance, transcribed in collections like Rinkaghyn Vannin.

basic_steps: Manx Reel Step: Three running steps keeping feet close to ground.
Hop: A hop on the fourth beat with a slight inward kick of the free foot.
Arching: Two couples join hands to form an arch for others to pass under.
teaching.formation: Processional, any number of two pairs of dancers.
teaching.level_notes: Highly accessible for children; taught in Manx schools from a young age.
teaching.rhythm: Two parts, each consisting of eight bars of music.
